name: Eastern & Oriental Hotel
address: George Town seafront, Penang; confirm exact event entrance with hotel
fact: The official events page confirms a Grand Ballroom seating 400. The Wedding Notebook also describes a seafront garden ceremony for 60 guests and a Macalister Ballroom reception of up to 30 tables. Those additional capacities are third-party references, not newly confirmed hotel guarantees. Ask about the garden rental, gallery seating and wet-weather alternative. No verified banquet price is recorded.

name: Shangri-La Rasa Sayang, Penang
fact: The official wedding page links to the 2026 Timeless Celebration reception brochure, displaying RM3,088 nett with a minimum of 13 tables in the Marquee Tent or 20 in Pelangi Ballroom. It includes drinks, canapes, decoration choices, a tea ceremony room, audiovisual equipment and a two-night suite stay. The brochure does not explicitly state the price unit or seats per table, so this amount is excluded from the meal calculator. It states that 10% service charge and 8% government tax are included; no expiry is given. The Wedding Notebook describes a 300-guest ballroom and Raintree/Banyan garden ceremonies. Its older RM2,688 banquet and RM13,888 ceremony references are unconfirmed, not current hotel quotes.

name: PARKROYAL Penang Resort
fact: The official brochure offers Andaman Grand Ballroom receptions for 200-300 guests, an intimate Jintan 1 option and garden ceremonies for up to 60. The separate garden ceremony starts at RM10,888 nett, valid until 31 December 2026; it includes refreshments, flowers, seating, sound equipment and bridal flowers. Banquet customers can add a garden ceremony for RM8,888, subject to confirmation of terms. Ceremony costs are excluded from the banquet calculator. The Wedding Notebook also lists this resort; use the official brochure for package terms.
